name: Software Advice

sources.title: Third-party guide (July 2025) — Software Advice is part of the Gartner Digital Markets network with GetApp and Capterra; listing intake is a contact/onboarding-rep flow

conditions: Free basic listings exist but only after Software Advice determines the product is a fit for the site — intake is a contact form routed to a business-development/onboarding rep, not a self-serve publish
Paid 'Highly Qualified Leads' (HQL) program is the monetized tier; free listing is offered when the product fits but the vendor isn't ready for HQL
requirements: B2B software product matching a category Software Advice covers
Pricing information must be provided — it is not displayed publicly but is used to assign a $–$$$$$ range, and is required for listing
Real company contact details: work email and phone number — the flow routes to a human rep and may schedule a call
preparation: Product description consistent with any existing Capterra/GetApp profiles (same Digital Markets network; editorial cross-checks)
Pricing model details (not shown publicly, but required)
Company size, industry, work email, phone number
Prepared answers about product category, target users, differentiators, business model
workflow: Open the vendor information/get-listed intake (vendor portal is run by the Digital Markets network; the batch URL app.g2digitalmarkets.com/get-listed/start was bot-blocked to the fetcher but is plausibly the current intake host)
Provide contact details and brief product info
A business-development rep responds; they may schedule a call and qualify the product
Request the free basic listing if not joining the paid HQL program
Once approved, manage the profile via the Digital Markets vendor portal listings tab
watchFor: softwareadvice.com and g2digitalmarkets.com both 403 automated fetches — browser access needed to confirm the live form
This is a lead-gen business: expect upsell contact for the paid HQL program
The public 'Get Advice' flow on the homepage is the BUYER funnel — the vendor intake is the vendor information page / vendor portal, don't confuse them
Requires a phone number and likely a real sales conversation — not a quick directory submit
countsAsLive: A public product profile page exists on softwareadvice.com showing the product name, description and $–$$$$$ price range
unknowns: Whether app.g2digitalmarkets.com is the current canonical vendor intake (network appears rebranded from Gartner Digital Markets — verify in browser)
Exact fit criteria used by the qualification rep
